page_title: FIO 1-0 ATA | Fiorentina v Atalanta 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Fiorentina.
90+4' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) inside the box.
90+3' The main referee, Daniele Doveri, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+2' Isak Hien (Atalanta) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
86' Daniele Doveri shows the yellow card to Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) for a heavy challenge.
84' Substitution. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) has come on for Dodo.
84' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Nicolo Fagioli and he is replaced by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
84' Moise Kean comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina).
83' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) whips in a cross from the corner, but David de Gea is well positioned and punches the ball away.
82' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
81' The ball is cleared after Dodo (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
80' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
77' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Isak Hien (Atalanta) for a tough tackle.
75' Here comes a substitution. Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Mario Pasalic.
75' Tullio Gritti prepares a substitution. Davide Zappacosta is replaced by Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta).
74' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Doveri had a clear view and blows his whistle.

73' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Marco Carnesecchi anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
72' Dodo (Fiorentina) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
71' Raffaele Palladino is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) suffers an injury and Michael Folorunsho comes on.
70' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
69' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
69' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
67' Here is a change. Albert Gudmundsson is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
65' Substitution. Charles De Ketelaere makes way for Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
65' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
65' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
62' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
61' Atalanta fail to score from a corner as David de Gea (Fiorentina) leaps to collect the ball.
58' Looks like Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' Tullio Gritti decides to make a substitution. Mateo Retegui will be replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
55' Here comes a substitution. Ademola Lookman is given a rest as he is replaced by Daniel Maldini (Atalanta).
54' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
52' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
49' What a big chance! Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
49' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' 1 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Moise Kean (Fiorentina) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:0.
44' Referee Daniele Doveri signals NO PENALTY for Atalanta after a VAR review!
44' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Atalanta! Let's see what he decides.
44' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
42' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
41' My Gran could have done better! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
39' Fiorentina control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
37' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
34' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
32' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
30' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' The game is interrupted as Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is flagged offside.
28' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
25' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
24' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Ademola Lookman was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
22' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
20' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and it's Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
20' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

19' A pass lands at the feet of Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
17' Flag up against Moise Kean (Fiorentina). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
14' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
12' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
10' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
7' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
4' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
3' It looks like Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Doveri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Atalanta will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri will supervise the game today.
